answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1428 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the opal. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the zenith queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The thread index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 275 pays that 136 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
